Hi Marissa / Priya,

Thanks again for the pen test summary you provided last month. Our InfoSec team has run a preliminary review and asked for concrete evidence of the remediation items referenced in the report for the Acme scope (networking and auth findings). Specifically they requested:

- Screenshots showing the updated WAF rule that blocks the observed attack vector
- Config snippet (redacted keys ok) demonstrating the DB connection config change and the applied parameter that mitigates SQL timing issues
- Ticket IDs and links for the remediation work (we need auditability)
- Any compensating controls you added (IDS/monitoring alerts, rate limiting, fallback policies) and brief descriptions

Can you provide those artifacts or point us to a secure location where they are available? Ideally we'd get this by EOD Friday (2026-03-12) so Acme can close the items in our tracker. If any of the items are not shareable, please provide a compensating control description and timeline for when redacted artifacts will be available.

Appreciate it — we can hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,

Hi team — I've pulled the artifacts and summarized what we can share. See attachments (attached to this thread): INF-3421-ticket-export.pdf, db-migration-config-snippet.txt, waf-rule-screenshot.png, k8s-pod-security-policy.png. Short notes below: 

- Ticket(s): INF-3421 (DB param tuning and connection pool changes) and INF-3422 (WAF rules and edge ACL updates). Export includes timestamps and engineer assignments. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421 (internal).

- DB config snippet: redacted for credentials; shown change is setting connection timeout and prepared-statement parameter that mitigates observed timing-based vector. See db-migration-config-snippet.txt.

- WAF: screenshot (waf-rule-screenshot.png) shows rule ID 7865 blocking the payload pattern described in the pen test. Rule applied at the edge CDN layer on 2026-02-18 and pushed to dedicated WAF-cluster-2. Compensating control: edge rate-limiting and anomaly alerts were added (rule 7865 triggers an alert to PagerDuty and fires an IDS signature).

- Additional control: Pod security policy tightened for the affected microservice; screenshot attached (k8s-pod-security-policy.png) showing the updated PSP and the admission controller policy rule.

Notes about sharing: the Jira links are internal; for Acme we can provide a rendered PDF export (INF-3421-ticket-export.pdf) which includes the remediation summary and timestamps. The config snippet has all secrets redacted. If Acme requires deeper access we should sign an NDA / secure evidence transfer; otherwise the artifacts attached should satisfy standard evidence requests.

If you want I can redact further or add a one-page memo explaining compensating controls and evidence provenance.
